name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text:
The European Parliament welcomes a plan to update EU guidance on smoke- and aerosol-free spaces. It wants countries to extend smoking bans to outdoor places like playgrounds, school and hospital grounds, public transport stops and parks. It also wants the rules to cover newer products such as e-cigarettes and heated tobacco, not just traditional cigarettes. The aim is to protect people, especially children, young people and pregnant women, from second-hand smoke and aerosols. The Parliament also asks for more research on the health risks of these newer products.

- Countries are urged to widen smoking bans to more outdoor areas and to newer products.
- It affects smokers, vapers and bystanders, especially children and pregnant women.
- The Commission should report back in four years on progress; more research is requested.
